meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码结构（AST 形状）而不是文本内容来搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种语言。它可以找出所有形状相同的函数、调用、类、导入，并在真正改写文件前先给出预览。
howto.when: 当你的目标是语法形状（如某种形状的调用、类或导入等）而非字面文本时触发；若要检索字符串内容、注释、文件名，则应改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 运行 search，先看匹配结果再决定是否改写。

say.text: 把所有 console.log(x) 改写成 logger.info(x)
扫描这个仓库的 YAML 规则并列出违规

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by AST shape instead of literal text, across 25 languages. It finds every function, call, class or import shaped like X, and previews rewrites before applying them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target is a syntax shape (calls, classes, imports shaped like X, a codemod, or a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for string contents, comments or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter
say_en.note: Runs search; review matches before rewriting.
Dry-run by default; add --apply to mutate files.

say_en.text: Scan this repo's YAML rules and list violations
say_en.note: Runs sg scan; try --report-style short for CI.
